assignments.package_label_en: The Patriarchs and the Wilderness Gifts
assignments.reason: Da'at (knowledge/consciousness) is the unified cognitive faculty through which the three patriarchal gifts flow. The source text (section ה) states: 'כִּי עַל־יְדֵי הַדַּעַת בָּאִים תְּלָת הַנַּ"ל, שֶׁהֵם: אֲכִילָה וּשְׁתִיָּה וּמַלְבּוּשִׁים, כִּי בּוֹ כְּלוּלִים' — the three gifts are included within da'at. Da'at is then sustained by the Avot ('וְעִקַּר קִיּוּמוֹ שֶׁל הַדַּעַת עַל־יְדֵי הָאָבוֹת'). Its essential nature is the knowledge that encompasses the patriarchal gifts — it is the consciousness of Moshe who was comprised of all three Avot. It belongs in Package 1 as the cognitive dimension of the patriarchal domain, alongside the Avot who sustain it and the gifts that flow from it.

assignments.package_label_en: The Patriarchs and the Wilderness Gifts
assignments.reason: The Avot (Patriarchs) as a collective are the very core of Package 1. The source text (section ה) states: 'וְעִקַּר קִיּוּמוֹ שֶׁל הַדַּעַת עַל־יְדֵי הָאָבוֹת, שֶׁהֵם: חֶסֶד גְּבוּרָה תִּפְאֶרֶת'. The individual Patriarchs (Avraham, Yitzchak, Yaakov) are already in Package 1; this collective node ('the Avot') shares their essential nature as the patriarchal foundation. The text also says 'כִּי הָאָבוֹת הֵן בְּרִית' — the Avot are the covenant itself. Package 1 is the patriarchal domain; this node belongs there by essential nature.

assignments.package_label_en: The Patriarchs and the Wilderness Gifts
assignments.reason: The sustaining/establishment of da'at describes the state in which da'at is upheld through the three patriarchal qualities (Chesed, Gevura, Tiferet). Its essential nature is the maintained integrity of the patriarchal knowledge — it is not the Shabbat outcome or the malkhut sign, but the structural stability of the patriarchal wisdom-domain itself. The source text (section ה): 'וְעִקַּר קִיּוּמוֹ שֶׁל הַדַּעַת עַל־יְדֵי הָאָבוֹת'. This belongs in Package 1 alongside דעת, the Avot, and the sefirot that sustain it.

assignments.package_label_en: The Patriarchs and the Wilderness Gifts
assignments.reason: This describes the condition of wisdom being in its fullness and perfection — the state achieved when da'at is sustained by the three Avot. Its essential nature is the perfected state of chokhmah/da'at. The source text (section ה): 'וּכְשֶׁהַחָכְמָה בְּקִיּוּמָהּ וּבִשְׁלֵמוּתָהּ, אֲזַי הוּא בִּבְחִינַת: חַד עָל בֵּין תְּרֵין' — when wisdom is complete (through the patriarchal sustaining), then comes the capacity for warfare. The concept describes the patriarchal wisdom-domain at peak functioning. It belongs in Package 1.

assignments.package_label_en: The Patriarchs and the Wilderness Gifts
assignments.reason: Fighting God's wars is the martial capacity that emerges from perfected wisdom. Its essential nature is the battle-power of the Moshe-figure who is comprised of the three Avot. The source text (section ג) describes this warfare as flowing directly from the patriarchal covenant: 'וּבַכֹּחַ שֶׁהָיָה כָּלוּל מֵאָבוֹת הָיָה לוֹחֵם כְּנֶגֶד עֲמָלֵק, בִּבְחִינַת חֶרֶב נֹקֶמֶת נְקַם בְּרִית'. The war-making power is a direct expression of the patriarchal covenant-force — it is the Avot's collective strength wielded by Moshe. It belongs in Package 1 as the active/militant dimension of the patriarchal domain.

assignments.node_id: כשמכניע כל הצרים הרודפים אחר חלושי כח שבישראל, ומכניס אותם לעבודת השם יתברך
assignments.node_text: כְּשֶׁמַּכְנִיעַ כָּל הַצָּרִים הָרוֹדְפִים אַחַר חֲלוּשֵׁי כֹּחַ שֶׁבְּיִשְׁרָאֵל, וּמַכְנִיס אוֹתָם לַעֲבוֹדַת הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
connected_to: זוכה לחדש חדושין דאוריתא בשבת על חד תרין
assignments.package_label_en: The Patriarchs and the Wilderness Gifts
assignments.reason: Subduing all oppressors who pursue the weak in Israel and bringing them to serve God is the concrete expression of 'fighting God's wars' — the patriarchal covenant-power in action. Its essential nature is the battle-and-ingathering activity of the sage who wields the perfected patriarchal wisdom. The source text (section ה): 'וְאָז כְּשֶׁמַּכְנִיעַ כָּל הַצָּרִים... עַל־יְדֵי־זֶה זוֹכֶה לְחַדֵּשׁ חִדּוּשִׁין דְּאוֹרַיְתָא בְּשַׁבָּת'. This is the 'חד עָל בֵּין תְּרֵין' (Moshe entering between the two supporters) — the patriarchal warfare. While the result belongs to the Shabbat domain, the action itself is the Avot-powered conquest. It belongs in Package 1.

connected_to: אפשר להם לקבל שבת, בחינת תשובה, מחכם הנ"ל
assignments.package_label_en: Shabbat, Repentance, and the Double Portion of Torah
assignments.reason: Guarding speech is the prerequisite discipline for receiving Shabbat. Its essential nature is the protective condition that enables the Shabbat-teshuva reception. The source text (section י): 'כִּי שַׁבָּת תָּלוּי בִּשְׁמִירַת הַדִּבּוּר, בִּבְחִינַת: וְדַבֵּר דָּבָר — שֶׁלֹּא יְהֵא דִּבּוּרְךָ שֶׁל שַׁבָּת כְּדִבּוּרְךָ שֶׁל חֹל'. The Rebbe explicitly states that Shabbat depends on (תָּלוּי בְּ) guarding of speech. Shmirat hadibur is not a patriarchal concept or a malkhut-sign; it is the gateway condition of Shabbat itself. It belongs in Package 3 as the speech-discipline dimension of the Shabbat-teshuva domain.

assignments.node_id: אפשר להם לקבל שבת, בחינת תשובה, מחכם הנ"ל
assignments.node_text: אֶפְשָׁר לָהֶם לְקַבֵּל שַׁבָּת, בְּחִינַת תְּשׁוּבָה, מֵחָכָם הַנַּ"ל
assignments.package_label_en: Shabbat, Repentance, and the Double Portion of Torah
assignments.reason: This describes the state of being able to receive Shabbat-as-teshuva from the sage. Its essential nature IS the reception of Shabbat and teshuva — the very core of Package 3. The node text itself contains 'שַׁבָּת, בְּחִינַת תְּשׁוּבָה' — Shabbat as an aspect of teshuva. The source text (section י): 'אִי אֶפְשָׁר לָהֶם לְקַבֵּל שַׁבָּת, בְּחִינַת תְּשׁוּבָה, מֵחָכָם הַנַּ"ל, אֶלָּא עַל־יְדֵי שְׁמִירַת הַדִּבּוּר'. This belongs in Package 3 as the capacity-to-receive dimension of the Shabbat-teshuva cluster.

assignments.node_text: זוֹכֶה לְחַדֵּשׁ חִדּוּשִׁין דְּאוֹרַיְתָא בְּשַׁבָּת עַל חַד תְּרֵין
connected_to: כשמכניע כל הצרים הרודפים אחר חלושי כח שבישראל, ומכניס אותם לעבודת השם יתברך
assignments.package_label_en: Shabbat, Repentance, and the Double Portion of Torah
assignments.reason: Meriting to innovate Torah insights on Shabbat in doubled measure is the reward-state that embodies the Shabbat double-portion. Its essential nature is the doubled Shabbat-Torah revelation — the same domain as לֶחֶם מִשְׁנֶה and מִשְׁנֵה תּוֹרָה. The source text (section ה): 'עַל־יְדֵי־זֶה זוֹכֶה לְחַדֵּשׁ חִדּוּשִׁין דְּאוֹרַיְתָא בְּשַׁבָּת עַל חַד תְּרֵין, בִּבְחִינַת לֶחֶם מִשְׁנֶה, בְּחִינַת מִשְׁנֵה תּוֹרָה'. The text explicitly equates this with lechem mishneh and mishneh torah — both already in Package 3. It belongs in Package 3 as the experiential dimension of the double-Torah revelation.

assignments.package_label_en: Shabbat, Repentance, and the Double Portion of Torah
assignments.reason: Double abundance (שֶׁפַע כְּפוּלָה) is the essential nature of the doubled-portion that characterizes Shabbat. The source text (section ד): 'שֶׁעַל־יְדֵי בְּרִית זוֹכֶה לְשֶׁפַע כְּפוּלָה'. This doubled bounty is then immediately identified with Shabbat's lechem mishneh: 'וְזֶה תְּרֵין יָנְקִין לְחַד, שֶׁבְּחִינַת שַׁבָּת מְקַבֵּל מִיּוֹסֵף לֶחֶם מִשְׁנֶה, הַיְנוּ מִשְׁנֵה תוֹרָה'. The double abundance IS the lechem mishneh/mishneh Torah in its material expression. It belongs in Package 3 alongside the other doubled-portion nodes.
